title: Open Weights and AI for All
summary: AI’s next frontier isn’t just about capability—it’s about who gets to use it. Our mission to put AI in the hands of as many people as possible is what drives us. Today’s release of our most capable open-weights models is a major step forward that makes advanced AI more open, flexible, and accessible worldwide.
body: AI’s next frontier isn’t just about capability—it’s about who gets to use it. Our mission to put AI in the hands of as many people as possible is what drives us. Today’s release of our most capable open-weights models is a major step forward that makes advanced AI more open, flexible, and accessible worldwide.
summaryZh: OpenAI正式宣布其开源权重战略，旨在通过发布高性能模型提升AI技术的全球可访问性与灵活性。此次发布不仅是技术能力的展示，更体现了公司在推动AI民主化方面的核心使命。通过提供更开放的模型权重，OpenAI试图打破技术壁垒，使开发者和研究人员能够在更广泛的场景中部署先进的AI能力，从而促进全球AI生态的协同创新与快速迭代，对行业格局产生深远影响。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI正式宣布转向开源权重模型，标志着其战略的重大转变。
